title: Chapter 448 Enemies From Outer Space
content:
Chapter 448 Enemies From Outer Space

"Senior, it's really a good method."

Lu Xue spoke gently, even if he was the ancestor of the Heavenly Demon Clan, he would call him Senior.

The era when Hao Yusheng lived is really too long and far away. It is a miracle to survive until now.

However, this is also a good thing for the Chaos Realm today.

Their combat power has been improved a little more.

As for how strong Hao Yusheng is now, no one is present.

Anyway, except Huangcheng, there should be no opponent.

And at this moment, an abnormal movement came from the combat power list.

The sacred aura emanated from the combat power list, and then, everyone on the list began to emit a faint light.

Whoosh, whoosh.

Several beams of light shot out from the combat power list, hitting these people on the list.

After a moment, these people showed excitement, joy and tears.

Rewards are issued.

The first settlement of the combat power list officially ended.

The strong man from the Heavenly Demon Clan was stunned. He thought that his ancestors could still make the list and compete for the Heavenly Demon Clan to make up for the regrets.

Unexpectedly, this is over.

Fortunately, this is just the first settlement, and there are still opportunities in the future.

"Senior Hao!"

At this time, some of the geniuses on the Tianjiao List gathered here.

These include Bai Xu and Bai Ling.

Bai Xu's face was extremely happy at this time, and he looked at Hao Yusheng with an excited expression.

"Senior Hao, you have finally recovered!"

When Hao Yusheng saw Bai Xu, he also smiled, "Boy Bai Xu, it's thanks to you."

Hearing this, Bai Xu scratched his head, smirked a few times before clasping his fists at Hao Yusheng and said, "It is an honor for me to be able to help seniors."

Hao Yusheng shook his head and smiled, "You guy, you are so slick."

"Senior Lu Xue."

Bai Ling came to Lu Xue and bowed respectfully.

Lu Xue looked at Bai Ling in front of her and said, "If you want to make it to the list, you can also give it a try."

Hearing this, Bai Ling shook his head slightly, "Thank you senior, Bai Ling just wants to accompany her brother and doesn't care about these things."

Seeing this, Lu Xue didn't say anything else.

At this moment, Ying Wuzhi looked at Lu Xue in the distance, a little nervous.

"Damn, Miss Lu Xue has come in person."

"Damn it, I just said why did that guy leave suddenly? It turned out that Miss Lu Xue is here. Hiss, Miss Lu Xue is here to supervise me personally, right?"

Thinking of this, Ying Wuzong shook his body, "If it is true, it would be terrible."

I haven't made it to the list yet. I thought I'd wait until the end to rush again, but now Lu Xue has arrived in person and dare not take advantage of the situation.

Just as Ying Wujie was preparing for himself, Lu Xue's eyes suddenly looked at him.

In desperation, Shadow Wuzhi thought and quickly entered the list of geniuses.

At the same time, a strange movement finally came from the Chaos Realm that had been silent for a long time.

As the huge black hole continues to expand, it has now covered almost half of the chaos world.

Rumble!

A irritable aura came from it.

In the deserted city, countless strong men suddenly looked up.

"Here you."

boom--

With a loud bang, a passage suddenly exploded in the black hole. Immediately afterwards, a golden avenue shot out from the black hole. Countless figures appeared on the avenue and walked towards this side.

Lu Xue's face was solemn, and she was the first to soar into the sky and came to the sky.

Seeing this, the other strong people followed closely.

"Are you finally here?"

Lu Xue's voice was solemn.

On the side, Hao Yusheng's figure appeared. At this time, a trace of hatred surged in Hao Yusheng's eyes, hidden very deeply and not revealed.

"If I was not mistaken, the light curtain left by that person should be weakening now."

Hearing this, Lu Xue did not hide it and nodded slightly, "Yes, facing the land of the gods, my current strength in the Chaos Realm is no match for me at all, but because of the existence of this light curtain, we still have no worries."

"Although it has been weakening, it can still give us a lot of breathing time. I estimate that if the other party pays some price, it should be able to allow their Heavenly Supreme Level strongmen to enter, or higher-level strongmen."

At this time, the light curtain was constantly weakening and there were some loopholes. As long as the other party was not stupid, they would definitely be able to discover those loopholes and continue to expand.

In this way, the enemy can enter the Chaos Realm in advance.

At this time, top powerhouses such as Wu Hui also appeared behind Lu Xue, looking at the golden avenue that penetrated the black hole, all with solemn expressions.

"Are you ready for the ants of the Chaos Realm?"

A hoarse and sinister laughter came from the black hole, and then a strange-looking figure with a sickle in his hand walked out of the black hole.

Seeing the Chaos Realm, the Scythe monster let out a hideous smile, then waved the sickle and slashed towards the light curtain of the Chaos Realm.

Buzz —

The light curtain emitted a strong light, which directly revived the sickle monster out.

Seeing this scene, Lu Xue and others did not feel any joy, just because the aura of this sickle monster was above the immortal supreme heaven.

This kind of strength is already beyond the strength of the Chaos Realm.

If there was no wasteland city and no Lu Daosheng, and relying solely on the Chaos Realm to resist the land of the gods, it would be a catastrophe for the Chaos Realm.

"Gahahahahahaha, skunk, you're such a waste. You can't even get into the Chaos Realm."

Another figure walked out of the black hole.

I saw that this creature looked no different from the human race, but it had three eyes on the first one, with long golden hair that attracted attention. At this time, the three-eyed creature had crazy eyes, and then rushed towards the light curtain of the Chaos Realm.

Bang!

Another loud noise.

The three-eyed creature was also shocked.

"So hard?"

The three-eyed creature shook his head, and a light appeared in his third eye, staring at the Chaos Realm tightly.

At this time, the shadows in the black hole were still large and the people in the Chaos World were in a daze.

"If the other party is of this kind of strength, then I don't think we need to fight."

A strong man suddenly spoke.

The rest of the people were silent.

But Lu Xue shook her head slightly, "Maybe this is just an accident. These two are strong, so they can come to the Chaos Realm as soon as possible, and the ones behind must be weaker than the two, so they are behind these two."

"If they set out at the same time," Lu Xue added.

After hearing these words, everyone felt it made sense and felt a little more confident.

As time passed, several figures appeared in the black hole one after another, and their strength was just as Lu Xue said. Although they were not much different from those two, they were not as strong as those two.

But it seems that there are many people behind the other party.

If this continues, the other party will be higher than their Chaos Realm, regardless of its mass or quantity.
